description: This source file defines an immutable Java class `PipelineFunctionUpper` that implements the `PipelineFunction` interface. It provides an implementation of the `fn:upper()` function, converting input strings to uppercase within a data processing pipeline. The class includes methods to get the function's name, signature, and apply the transformation after validating the input parameters. It also contains an inner class describing the function's signature.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionUpper
classes.description: Implements the fn:upper() function for transforming input strings to uppercase in a data processing pipeline.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the upper-case transformation to the provided PipelineElement if parameters are valid.
